entries.command:
cd "E:\github_maochenyu_me\BroadcastChannel" && [Console]::OutputEncoding=[Text.Encoding]::UTF8
Write-Output "=== 最终确认: 持久配置 ==="
Write-Output "AGENT_BROWSER_PROXY_BYPASS (User) = $([Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable('AGENT_BROWSER_PROXY_BYPASS','User').Substring(0,60))..."
Write-Output ""
Write-Output "=== 技能文字已放行 ==="
Select-String -Path "C:\Users\Administrator\.walicode\skills\agent-browser-core\SKILL.md" -Pattern "本地/内网地址默认放行" -Encoding UTF8 | ForEach-Object { Write-Output ("L" + $_.LineNumber + " ✓") }
Write-Output ""
Write-Output "=== 残留进程检查 ==="
$ab = Get-Process | Where-Object { $_.ProcessName -match "agent-browser" }
Write-Output "agent-browser 进程: $(($ab | Measure-Object).Count) 个"
$py = Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter "Name='python.exe'" -EA SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.CommandLine -like "*8765*" }
Write-Output "演示服务器: $(($py | Measure-Object).Count) 个"
